title: Sunday · the seawall in May
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: The seawall in May before the season: empty, the benches wet, a crow, and in the last tier the first rental's blinds going up across the street. Quiet before it isn't.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the seawall in May, empty, wet benches, gray bay.
